## Summary

FundRail is described everywhere as MIT-licensed, but there is no `LICENSE` file in the repo.
Add the standard MIT license text with the current copyright year and a neutral holder line
(e.g. "FundRail contributors").

## Files

- New file: `LICENSE`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `LICENSE` exists at the repo root with the MIT license text
- [ ] The license is referenced from `README.md` (the header already calls the project MIT-licensed)

## Notes

If you are unsure about the copyright holder, use "FundRail contributors" — this is a common
convention for open-source projects without a single corporate owner.
